claims.text: There are inherent trade-offs between key fairness conditions in algorithmic classification.
Methods for promoting fairness can be extended to classification and selection problems involving sets rather than individuals.

evidence.description: The paper discusses recent research establishing inherent trade-offs between competing fairness conditions for classification algorithms.
The authors examine methods for promoting fairness in classification and selection problems that act on sets.

methodologies.name: Theoretical Analysis of Fairness Conditions
methodologies.description: Evaluation and review of mathematical definitions and trade-offs among criteria for algorithmic fairness.

limitations.text: Multiple key fairness conditions in algorithmic classification cannot be simultaneously satisfied due to inherent trade-offs.
